## Activity

During March 2025, Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 438 captures. This activity represents the total number of image sets submitted for review during the month. The reported volume provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures outlined below.

## Image quality

Of the 438 captures, 24 were marked ungradable. This corresponds to an ungradable rate of 5.5 per cent. Ungradable images could not be assessed through the usual grading process and are reported separately from images that produced a grading outcome. Staff raised no new equipment faults during the month.

## Grading

Grading identified 115 referable results from the captures reviewed. The median lag between image capture and completion of grading was 1 day. These figures provide the monthly operational summary for Harbour Eye Clinic, covering activity, image suitability for assessment and the timeliness of the grading process. The results should be considered alongside the reported ungradable captures, as those images did not contribute to a standard grading outcome.
